findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("jsonpickle").getMember(["decode", "unpickler"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization using pickle, yaml, marshal, or shelve.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command Injection Search
 * @description Search for subprocess calls to identify potential command injection risks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/command-injection-search
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential command execution."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection via subprocess or os.system calls.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Context for pickle usage
 * @description Identify the function and arguments for pickle calls
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pickle-context
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Function f
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() and
  call.getScope() = f
select call, "Pickle call in function " + f.getName() + " with argument " + call.getArg(0).toString()

message.text: Pickle call in function _load with argument ControlFlowNode for f
